header.label: Get set up
header.progress: {settled, number} of {total, number} {total, plural, one {step} other {steps}}

state.scheduledInDays: Scheduled - runs in {days, number} {days, plural, one {day} other {days}} at {time} ({timezone})

create_project.active: Name the project you want to track. You can update its details later in Project settings.
create_project.done: This happened when you created the project: one domain, with every check and import scoped to it. The name and domain live in Project settings.

add_keywords.active: Type or paste your keywords, one per line. We dedupe against what you already track.
add_keywords.done: This happened when you added your first keywords. Each keyword carries its own market and device - edit them on the keyword's row in Rank Tracker.

connect_source.active: Search Console is free and takes two clicks. A SERP provider adds live position checks with your own key.
connect_source.done: This happened when you connected a data source. Rank checks run through it, and the provider bills you directly. Manage or swap it in Integrations.

first_check.active: Run the first check to collect positions for the tracked keywords. Check settings live in the project's tracking settings.
first_check.done: This happened when your first check completed: every keyword it covered now has a position and a ranking URL, and history builds from here. Checks follow the project's default schedule - any keyword can override it with its own. Both live in Rank Tracker.

competitors.blocked: Suggestions use your completed rank checks. This step opens after your first check.
competitors.ready: Choose competitors to track. You can change this later in Settings.
competitors.skipped: Skipped. Nothing is tracked as a competitor, and share of voice stays off until you confirm a set.
competitors.confirmed: Confirmed. Your selected competitors are now tracked.
competitors.none: No suggestions yet. Add a competitor or do this later in Settings.
competitors.select: Select the domains you want to track.
competitors.noneLeft: No suggestions left. You can add your own competitor.
competitors.confirmError: Could not confirm every selected competitor. Try again.
competitors.skipError: Competitor setup could not be skipped.

manual.aliasesHelp: Other brand names to match in citations, separated by commas.

suggestions.suggestedDescription: Appear on at least two different non-branded keywords.
suggestions.otherDescription: These results alone do not establish competition. Add a domain only if it competes with your site.
suggestions.evidence: seen on {seenOn, number} of {of, number} keywords / best #{bestPosition, number}

completion.heading: What's next
completion.acknowledged: Your setup is complete. You can return here whenever you need a reminder of how the project is connected.
completion.helper: Confirm the setup when you are ready. Your project keeps its existing data and settings.
completion.checklistError: Complete every setup step before finishing.
completion.writeError: Could not save setup completion. Try again.
